preconditions.description: The number of people n must be between 1 and 50.
The boat's weight limit k must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(w in {50, 100} for w in weights)
preconditions.description: All people's weights must be either 50 or 100 kilograms.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if any(w > k for w in weights) else True
postconditions.description: If any person's weight exceeds the boat's weight limit, output -1.
Output the minimum number of rides and the number of ways modulo 1000000007.
